name: ecommerce-dropshipping-livewire
description: One Livewire component for the shopper: what has been despatched of their own order, when it was promised, and the carrier references a supplier reported.
features: One component, because one shopper-facing fact exists: what has happened to the shopper's own order
No supplier reference, name or code reaches a shopper, and a boundary case asserts it over every file
No cost, no margin and no currency reaches a shopper; the word cost does not appear in the rendered output
Nothing here is an input to routing: there is no supplier control, no writable property and no domain action call
A promise nobody made renders as absent, never as an invented date
onTime null is rendered as unknown, never as late; null and false are different facts
Partly despatched and fully despatched are different sentences, and the per-line quantities are shown for the first
A despatch with no carrier reported shows the tracking reference without inventing a carrier
No such order, not your order, an erased destination and an order with nothing to despatch are one answer
Every public property is locked; the writable set and the submittable set are both empty
Every concrete domain exception is classified, and none of the messages names a reference or a supplier
